thread:
anya: heads up — noticed ~120 leads in last 12h that stayed in 'Nurture Pending' because enrichment webhook timed out. HubSpot shows owner=null. Anyone seen this pattern?

lucas: yep, saw a few spikes. looks like the round-robin assign job is skipped when enrichment==pending for >10m. :thinking_face:

olivia: this is causing SLA misses for SDRs — follow-ups are not getting routed. we should add a deterministic fallback so leads don't sit unowned. recommend: fallback assign after X minutes and tag as 'needs_enrichment' so reps know not to start outreach.

sam: quick summary of current logic: HubSpot workflow only sets owner when enrichment.status == 'complete'. if enrichment timed out we leave owner blank. that was to avoid pushing bad data to Salesforce. but in practice leads are unassigned for too long.

lucas: proposal: add a workflow step after 7 minutes that assigns a temporary owner, but use a special bucket like "queue:unverified-rr". also set a property enrichment_fallback=true and enrichment_attempts++. that way we can exclude that owner from SF pushes.

anya: agree with the fallback bucket. the main pain is our SF push rule — any non-null owner triggers push to Salesforce. we either change push mapping or use a property to inhibit the push.

olivia: here's the pseudo-workflow I sketched for HubSpot:

```
# HubSpot workflow pseudocode
if enrichment.status == 'complete':
    owner = rr.next()
    hubspot.push_to_sf = true
else if enrichment.elapsed_minutes >= 7:
    owner = rr.next()  # fallback bucket or rr candidate depending on config
    enrichment_fallback = 'true'
    hubspot.push_to_sf = false  # inhibit SF until enrichment completes
else:
    keep owner = null
```

sam: +1. alternatively we could set owner but also set hubspot.owner_type = 'fallback' and have middleware ignore owner_type=='fallback' when deciding to push. less workflow churn.

lucas: note — if we set a bucket owner that is a real user it will create ownership thrash when enrichment completes and we reassign. prefer either an unassigned queue or a dedicated fallback user/group.

hubspot-sync-bot: 124 leads failed enrichment webhook between 2026-03-20T03:10Z and 2026-03-20T14:45Z. upstream enrich service returned 504 on multiple retries.

olivia: ok, immediate action plan:
- change HubSpot workflow: fallback assign after 7m -> set enrichment_fallback=true and hubspot.push_to_sf=false (olivia)
- update SF middleware to ignore leads where hubspot.push_to_sf == false (lucas)
- add alert on enrichment webhook 5-min failure rate > 20% (sam)
- patch runbook with reassign procedure and customer-facing SLA wording (anya)

anya: can we also add a lightweight tag visible in SF so AE/SDR knows why a lead was routed early? maybe "Fallback:EnrichPending" so they can deprioritize.

lucas: yep, we can add a mapped field 'lead_routing_note' and set to 'Fallback:EnrichPending' when enrichment_fallback=true. middleware will forward that to SF but only if push_to_sf==true (so in fallback case we keep it internal).

sam: i'll update the runbook and add the alert. olivia, can you push the workflow changes in staging? i can test with replayed webhook failures.

olivia: will do. planning to deploy workflow change + property updates to staging by EOD PST. i'll post screenshots in this thread once done. :sparkles:

anya: thanks all — big ask: let's prioritize preventing SLA breaches tomorrow morning. tagging @sales-ops FYI.

lucas: quick follow-up — do we want exponential backoff retries for enrichment before we fallback? we currently do 3 quick retries. maybe add jitter + longer retry window to avoid mass fallback during transient upstream slowness.

olivia: good call. increase retries to 6 with backoff (30s, 60s, 120s, 5m, 10m, 20m) and only fallback after those. will include in the staging change.

hubspot-sync-bot: note: created ticket #ENG-7241 for enrich-service 504s, linked to this thread.

anya: perfect. action owners: olivia (workflow + retries), lucas (middleware filter + note mapping), sam (alert + runbook), anya (SLA copy + comms). ETA: staging changes today, production rollout tomorrow morning after smoke tests. :thumbsup:

olivia: ack, will post results and screenshots.

sam: thanks — adding to release checklist.

anya: closing loop later with a short postmortem if we still see leakage after the change.

lucas: thanks everyone.
